newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Action price targets raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Action price targets raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it is increasing its target prices on Action Performance Cos Inc to $29 from $26 for the six months and to $39 from $35 for the 18 months based on the belief that the company's visibility as a pure play on the growth of auto racing has increased.
-- "Our investment thesis for the company has been that shares of Action Performance Cos represent the best way to invest in auto racing," said analyst Steven Bernard in a report.
--Action Performance's stock was off 1/4 at 24-1/4. The company produces motorsports car replicas.
